name: io.github.ilpr/waitlister
description: Create waitlists, landing pages, manage subscribers, referrals, and view stats on Waitlister.

environmentVariables.name: WAITLISTER_ACCOUNT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Account API key (wl_acct_…) from waitlister.me Settings → API keys. Works on every plan; enables waitlist creation and all landing-page tools.

environmentVariables.name: WAITLISTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Legacy alternative: per-waitlist API key (wl_…, Growth+ plans) used together with WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Default waitlist key for per-waitlist-key mode or to scope tools to one waitlist.
